subject: Exclusive Summer Sale - Limited Time Only!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our exclusive summer sale happening now! Enjoy up to 50% off on select items like swimwear, sunglasses, and beach accessories. Don't miss out on this limited time offer to refresh your summer wardrobe. Visit our store or shop online to grab these amazing deals before they're gone. Hurry, stock is limited! We look forward to helping you find your perfect summer essentials. Best regards, The Summer Chic Team
